program.name: Fighter 35
program.subject: Fighter
program.blurb: Thirty-five minutes of fight training: bouts, then a strength circuit or a strength AMRAP.
program.about: Fight training for about half an hour. Each day opens with bouts, then a strength circuit of lifts and bodyweight moves one day and an AMRAP of swings, goblet squats and push-ups the next. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Bouts & strength circuit / bouts & strength AMRAP, 35 minutes
